title: Fixed Domed Grid Fencing Mask Display
description: One newly authored complete static fencing-mask display. Twenty-six complete closed bowed metal wires form a genuinely open convex elliptical face cage, all ending in one thick continuous oval rim. The rear remains open and two complete fixed retention arches meet the rim; a broad closed canvas-coloured throat bib descends from the lower perimeter to a finite flat display edge. The front is not an opaque visor, painted grid, cylindrical bee veil, or solid diving-helmet shell with window decals. All numeric mask geometry is new, with no head, mannequin, sword, stand, transparent texture or equipment scene. Three solid opaque PBR roles, metre units, Z up and whole horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. One static prop and zero scenes. Coarse game-art wires and fixed bands only: no wearer/head fit, fastening, impact or puncture resistance, vision, certified mesh spacing, protective efficacy, manufacture or sports safety claim.
